root_review: Verified private duration/gap helpers have only Validate and Synthesize callers; public signatures can remain unchanged.
Existing checkedProduct and checkedAdd operate on nonnegative int64. Final native int and float64 byte bounds require separate checks on 32-bit platforms.
bits.Mul64/Div64 as used by audio.resampleOutputLength can preserve wide products, but synthesis must truncate rather than round.
Unused gap for a single character must not cause a new refusal; Generate n=0 still validates config and min/max ordering and returns a nonnil empty slice.

Root independently modeled all five rejection rows on both 32 and 64 bits: original allocations are 0, 1, 2 or negative/recoverable; no large allocation is needed to prove the defect.
